This video breaks down the exact strategy to handle falling markets, decide when to average your stocks, and deploy your capital safely.
Before putting fresh money into a falling stock, assess your financial readiness. The core rule is time: only invest capital you can comfortably leave in the market for the next 5 years to ride out the recovery cycle. You also need a sustainable plan to bring in fresh capital over the next 2 to 4 years in case the market drops further. Never invest borrowed money or break your emergency funds; rely strictly on your actual monthly surplus.
